verdict.rationale: Rippling's payroll page says you can "run payroll on your schedule" and "process payroll as often as you need — at no extra charge," which covers runs outside the regular cycle. It also documents adding one-off bonuses in seconds and using one-off pay types. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a named off-cycle payroll run type, evidence for correction and termination/final-pay runs specifically, independent or hands-on corroboration.
